name: The Uniform Log Auction
description: Fifty log entries report AuthFailure at exact 2,000-second intervals with identical entropy. A naive system would see 50 failures and conclude brute-force attack. But memory shows no process generating those events.

custodyEvents.detail: Auth log anomaly flagged by monitoring.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Anomalía en el log de autenticación marcada por monitoreo.

custodyEvents.detail: Log file and a memory snapshot acquired.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Archivo de log e instantánea de memoria adquiridos.

custodyEvents.detail: Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.
custodyEvents.detail_es: El motor determinista corrió sobre los artefactos adquiridos.

artifacts.description: 50 AuthFailure events at 2,000s ± 0.001s intervals and entropy 3.145 ± 0.002. Inhumanly precise — real attacks and real humans have variance, not exact intervals.
artifacts.description_es: 50 eventos AuthFailure con intervalos 2.000s ± 0.001s y entropía 3.145 ± 0.002. Inhumana precisión.

artifacts.description: Memory scan: NO brute-force tool running. No network sockets match the source IP from the logs. Pure context — this artifact shows the absence of corroboration, it doesn't itself trip a detector.
artifacts.description_es: Memory scan: NO hay herramienta de fuerza bruta en ejecución. No hay sockets de red que coincidan con la IP origen de los logs.

peirce_chain.firstness: 50 AuthFailure log entries with near-perfect 2s intervals.
peirce_chain.secondness: Memory does not confirm an attacking process; the logs have no technical counterpart.
peirce_chain.thirdness: The logs are fabricated via scripted injection. Strong signal but no independent corroboration.

demo_quote: A naive system sees 50 failures and screams MALICE. VELO detects that the temporal variance is inhuman — but a single detector, from a single source, can never reach MALICE on its own (max category weight is below the threshold by design). Strong signal, but one source: SUSPICION.
description_es: Cincuenta entradas de log reportan AuthFailure con intervalos exactos de 2.000 segundos y entropía idéntica. Un sistema naive vería 50 fallos y concluiría ataque de fuerza bruta. Pero la memoria no muestra ningún proceso que genere esos eventos.
demo_quote_es: Un sistema naive ve 50 fallos y grita MALICE. VELO detecta que la varianza temporal es inhumana y que la memoria contradice los logs. Señal fuerte, pero una sola fuente: SUSPICION.

peirce_chain_es.firstness: 50 AuthFailure log entries con near-perfect 2s intervals.
peirce_chain_es.secondness: Memoria no confirma proceso atacante; los logs no tienen contraparte técnica.
peirce_chain_es.thirdness: Los logs son fabricados mediante inyección scriptada. Hay señal fuerte pero no corroboración independiente.
